title: Concept: Gemfile source declared over cleartext
description: Gemfile declares a gem source URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Gems and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different gem.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: Gems and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different gem.
